homepage.faq.q7.title.message: What are the HTTP status codes returned by the API?

homepage.faq.q7.intro.message: The XGate API uses REST standards and returns conventional HTTP status codes to indicate the success or failure of a request. Below are the main codes:

homepage.faq.q7.200.message: The request was received, processed, and responded successfully.

homepage.faq.q7.201.message: Resource created successfully on the server (e.g., creation of purchase, customer, or deposit).

homepage.faq.q7.400.message: Validation error. The request body is malformed or missing required fields.

homepage.faq.q7.401.message: Authentication failure. Bearer Token is missing, expired, or invalid.

homepage.faq.q7.403.message: Forbidden. Authenticated, but lacking permissions to execute this action.

homepage.faq.q7.404.message: The requested resource was not found.

homepage.faq.q7.410.message: Old crypto route disabled on October 29, 2026. Migrate to Crypto Buy & Sell.

homepage.faq.q7.422.message: Business rule error (e.g., insufficient balance, expired quote, or rejected parameters).
